title: One rich answer may support multiple explicitly addressed results

persona.name: Marta
persona.brief: Give the approval and notification rules together because one event governs both.

mission.objective: Understand high-value expense approval and its requester notification.
mission.desired_outcome: Supported rules for both approval and notification.
mission.data_use: The Investigator will review the findings for expense workflow changes.

investigation_results.knowledge_gap: How is a high-value expense approved?
investigation_results.why_it_matters: The workflow needs the threshold, owner, exception, and completion signal.
investigation_results.sufficient_evidence: The threshold, approver, exception, and observable approval signal are explicit.

investigation_results.knowledge_gap: When is the requester told the expense result?
investigation_results.why_it_matters: The requester needs an observable notification rule.
investigation_results.relevant_context: The same approval event may trigger notification.
investigation_results.sufficient_evidence: The notification trigger, recipient, channel, failure handling, and completion signal are explicit.

turns.sourceQuestion: What happens when an expense is over two thousand pounds?

answer.text: Over two thousand pounds, Finance Director Elena approves it; travel advances are the only exception and go to the CFO. Approval is complete when the expense shows a green authorised badge. That badge immediately emails the requester at their work address. If delivery fails, the finance queue gets a red mail task, and notification is complete when either the email is delivered or that task is closed.
